ns2:section.sectionText: Explore modern and contemporary German culture through examples of popular culture from the late-eighteenth century to the present. Look at texts and films as a mirror and critique of modern German society. Topics to be discussed: nationalism, gender, ethnicity, minority cultures, Jewish life in Germany, German images of other cultures, etc. Course taught in English. This course satisfies the General Education requirements for Cultural Studies - Western and for Literature and the Arts.
